question_en:
The local history exhibition plans to select stock certificates featuring human figures from the Earl Bennett Stock Certificates collection at the University of Idaho Library. Examine all records in the complete metadata of this collection where the identifier starts with `14-`; records with different identifiers must be evaluated separately even if the company name is the same. Certificates displaying human figures, portraits, or group scenes on the front are marked as 'Selected'; those without human figures are marked as 'Not Selected'. Please answer:

Which certificates meet the above identifier criteria? List the collection identifier and company name for each certificate. Which certificates are selected and which are not? Provide the judgment result item by item. Summarize the collection identifiers separately under 'Selected' and 'Not Selected'.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of 'Collection Identifier—Company Name—Judgment', followed by a Q&A section summarizing the collection identifiers under 'Selected' and 'Not Selected' respectively.
